state.grant: A single user's previously inactive platform-operator privilege becomes active. The source event belongs to that user's independent operator aggregate, not the legacy global roster.
state.revoke: An active unprotected user's exact platform-operator grant episode becomes inactive on that user's independent aggregate.

privilege_granted.instructions: Does PlatformOperatorPrivilegeGranted precisely name state.grant as a completed per-user business fact?

access_granted.instructions: Does PlatformOperatorAccessGranted precisely name state.grant as a completed per-user business fact?

status_granted.instructions: Does PlatformOperatorStatusGranted precisely name state.grant as a completed per-user business fact?

privilege_revoked.instructions: Does PlatformOperatorPrivilegeRevoked precisely name state.revoke as a completed per-user business fact?

access_revoked.instructions: Does PlatformOperatorAccessRevoked precisely name state.revoke as a completed per-user business fact?
